items.ti: 우리나라를 위대하게 만들기 위해 열심히 일한 모든 미국 애국자들에게 감사를 드립니다! 아울러, 선거 직전에 가짜 경제 수치를 발표하고, 이를 3주 늦게 어제 수정하여 실제로 GDP가 4.3% 대 3.4%인 기록 설정 오류, 즉각 조사해야 할 중대한 오류임을 표시한 분들께도 행복한 추수감사절을 기원하고 싶습니다. 또한 나는 우리 나라를 급진적 극좌파로 만들기 위해 열심히 노력한 모든 사람들, 법원 시스템을 샤리아 제도로 바꾸려는 사람들, 재산을 재분배하여 평생 동안 특정 부를 축적해 온 모든 열심히 일하는 사람들이 이제 국가 전체에, 심지어 일을 거부하는 사람들에게도 그것을 분배하도록 강요당하게 되기를 원하는 모든 사람들에게 매우 행복한 추수감사절을 기원하고 싶습니다. 나는 소말리아 인구의 2%에게 감사를 표하고 싶습니다.
items.ti_en: HAPPY THANKSGIVING TO ALL AMERICAN PATRIOTS WHO HAVE WORKED SO HARD TO MAKE OUR COUNTRY GREAT! Additionally, I would like to wish a Happy Thanksgiving to even those who issued fake Economic Numbers, just prior to the Election, and corrected them yesterday, three weeks late, showing that the GDP was actually 4.3%, versus 3.4%, A RECORD SETTING ERROR, and one so grave that it should be immediately investigated. Also, I would like to wish a very Happy Thanksgiving to all of those people that have worked so hard to bring our Country to the Radical Far Left, those that are looking to change our Court System to that of Sharia, those who want to redistribute Property, so that all of the hardworking people that have built up, over a lifetime, a certain Wealth, will now be forced to distribute it throughout the Country, even to those who refuse to work. I want to thank the 2% of our Somalian population that have a job, and are actually willing to work, without receiving Government Assistance. These are wonderful American “citizens,” and should be allowed to stay in our Country, and celebrate Thanksgiving with us. The others should be thrown out, immediately, thereby saving the Great State of Minnesota, which has no chance if they are allowed to stay. I want to commiserate with those Reporters and Citizens who don’t understand filth, dirt, lack of maintenance, and corruption, and are upset with me because I took time out of my very busy schedule to fix the 17 broken windows, numerous chipped and decaying columns, broken, dilapidated, and missing moldings, and lack of a proper plaster and paint job on the White House. It hasn’t been properly painted, or taken care of, for years. I felt strongly that, after being built in 1792, it was time to fix up the White House which is, after all, a primary symbol of our Country. Today, it has never looked better, and will soon have the Ballroom that Presidents have sought for over 150 years. Most importantly, thank you to the murderers, drug dealers, and criminals of all shapes, sizes, and colors, who illegally entered our Country from other countries’ jails, prisons, mental institutions, and places unknown, to rape, plunder, and kill American Citizens in record numbers. They are mostly gone now, brought back to their point of origin and, hopefully, living a beautiful and idyllic life, and promising, ideally, never to kill innocent people again, but we won’t have to worry about that, because they are GONE but, Happy Thanksgiving to them anyway, even though from Faraway Lands. We miss you dearly, but you will never be back, and America will never allow what you have done to us to happen again! President DONALD J. TRUMP

items.ti: 나는 중국에서 러시아의 블라디미르 푸틴 대통령과 대화하는 동안 푸틴 대통령이 러시아와 우크라이나 사이에 협상이 빨리 타결되기를 바라며 유럽 전역의 영토에 대한 모든 군사적 공격을 철회하는 것을 보고 싶다는 사실에 대해 많은 시간을 보냈습니다. 저는 이것이 가능성이 매우 높다고 믿습니다. 매달 수천 명의 사람들이 완전한 유혈 사태로 죽임을 당하고 있으며 모두에게 큰 찬사가 될 것입니다! 어젯밤 Mar-a-Lago에서 NATO 사무총장 Mark Rutte와의 명예 회담이었는데, 그곳에서 많은 주제가 논의되었고, 저는 푸틴 대통령과의 회담에 대해 그에게 업데이트했습니다. 이 문제에 관심을 가져주셔서 감사합니다! 도널드 J. 트럼프 대통령
items.ti_en: During my conversations in China with President Vladimir Putin, of Russia, I spent a lot of time talking about the fact that I would like to see President Putin pull back all Military aggression against territories throughout Europe, in the hopes that a Deal can be made between Russia and Ukraine, and made quickly. I really believe this is a strong possibility — Thousands of people are being killed each and every month, A COMPLETE BLOODBATH — and will be a Great Tribute to everyone! It was an Honor meeting with Secretary General of NATO, Mark Rutte, last night at Mar-a-Lago, where many topics were discussed, and in which I updated him on my talks with President Putin. Thank you for your attention to this matter! President DONALD J. TRUMP

items.ti: 선거 전에 발표된 실제 경제 수치가 가짜라는 사실이 방금 밝혀졌고, 이 수치를 처리하는 정부 기관의 사람들이 어제 정정 내용을 발표했습니다. 트럼프 행정부 하의 미국 경제는 이미 발표된 좋은 수치보다 훨씬 더 나은 성과를 보이고 있습니다. 3분기 GDP 성장률이 이제 3.4%가 아닌 4.3%로 수정되었습니다. 이는 큰 차이입니다! 선거 전에 정확한 번호가 발급되지 않은 이유는 무엇입니까? 이 상황에 대한 즉각적인 조사를 요청합니다. 이것은 작은 오류가 아니라 거대하고 의도적인 오류입니다. 이 문제에 관심을 가져주셔서 감사합니다. 도널드 J. 트럼프 대통령
items.ti_en: It was just revealed that the REAL Numbers on the Economy, published before the Election, were FAKE, and a correction was issued yesterday by the people in the Government Agency that does these numbers. The American Economy under The Trump Administration is doing FAR BETTER than the good numbers already released. Third Quarter GDP Growth has now been corrected to be 4.3%, instead of 3.4%, a major difference! Why wasn’t the correct number issued before the Election? I am asking for an immediate investigation of this situation. This is not a small error, this is a massive, and purposeful, error. Thank you for your attention to this matter. President DONALD J. TRUMP

items.ti: 도널드 J. 트럼프 대통령과 마크 루테 나토 사무총장의 공동 성명: 트럼프 대통령과 루테 사무총장은 수요일 저녁 남부 백악관인 마라라고(Mar-a-Lago)에서 훌륭한 회담을 가졌습니다. 이 회담은 러시아와 우크라이나 간의 전쟁, 이란의 분쟁이 주요 논의 주제가 되어 매우 영향력이 컸습니다. 또한, 헤이그와 앙카라 정상회담에서 미국과 NATO가 함께 이룩한 모든 기록적인 성과에 대해 논의했습니다. 또한 우리는 러시아와 우크라이나가 의도적 또는 의도하지 않게 전쟁을 확대하는 모든 행동을 피하는 것의 중요성과 가능한 한 빨리 전쟁에 대한 평화적 해결을 얻는 것이 중요하다는 점에 대해 이야기했습니다. 마지막으로 우리는 미국과 미국의 국방비 지출과 산업 기반에 대한 투자에 대해 논의했습니다.
items.ti_en: A JOINT STATEMENT MADE BY PRESIDENT DONALD J. TRUMP AND SECRETARY GENERAL OF NATO, MARK RUTTE: President Trump and Secretary General Rutte had an outstanding meeting on Wednesday evening, at what is often referred to as the Southern White House — Mar-a-Lago.The meeting was very impactful, with the War between Russia and Ukraine, and the Conflict in Iran, being the primary subjects of discussion. Additionally, all of the record setting achievements that the U.S. and NATO have made together at the Summits in the Hague, and Ankara, were discussed.We also talked about, at length, the importance of Russia and Ukraine avoiding any actions that intentionally, or unintentionally, expand the War — and the importance of obtaining a peaceful resolution to the War, as rapidly as possible!Lastly, we discussed Defense Spending, and the Investment in our Industrial Base, both in the United States, and all across NATO. I briefed NATO on the tremendous progress our Defense Companies are making on more than 20 new facilities currently under construction. The focus of these Companies is the building of Patriots, THAAD Systems, Tomahawks, and many new Weapons, both Offensive and Defensive, that have not yet been viewed by the Public, or other Countries. There has never been a time when the United States has produced more Military Equipment or Munitions than now. Our “cupboard” will soon be full and, when it is, our Allies and Partners throughout the World will be benefitting greatly. Thank you for your attention to this matter!
